crm_notes: Key contact: Maya Patel (Head of Search) - "need sub-200ms rerank latencies for UX". Primary workload: media archive search across legacy transcripts, video captions, and press PDFs. Typical queries are long (2-4 sentence context) + filtering by metadata (date, show). They emphasized cost visibility — want per-query cost estimate for average 3k token context. Interested in Redwood's reranker workflow: embed->ANN->top-K->rerank using cross-encoder. "We must avoid full cross-encoder on top 1000 candidates" — they'd prefer 10-50 reranker candidates. Legal: some catalogs must stay on-prem / within VPC. POC scope proposed: 10M chunks (approx 5TB of text) covering 5 years of archives. SE suggested hybrid approach: offload embeddings to hosted/dedicated; run reranker on private nodes.
requirements_summary: POC: scalable embeddings index + tuned reranker. Targets: 95th percentile rerank latency <= 250ms end-to-end for UI flows (embedding lookup + feature scoring + cross-encoder on N candidates). Throughput: 40 qps sustained during peak ingest. Index must support 10M-20M chunks initially, ability to shard by show/year. Strong data residency and audit logs for regulated partners. Cost sensitivity: procurement wants unit cost below $0.15/query (avg) for typical searches.
indexing_scale_estimates: Baseline estimates provided by Sonatasearch team: ~5TB raw text -> after chunking (avg chunk size 1.5k tokens) => ~10M chunks. Embedding dim 1536 (model family), index storage ~1.5TB compressed + metadata. Expected monthly embedding compute for re-embedding delta ~200k documents/month. Top-K candidate retrieval target K=100 for recall experiments.
chunking_strategy_notes: Discussed multiple chunking strategies: 1) fixed-token sliding window (1.5k tokens, 50% overlap) to preserve context across paragraph breaks; 2) semantic segmentation via speaker/scene boundaries for transcripts; 3) hybrid: shorter chunks (500-800 tokens) for captions, longer (2k) for long-form articles. AE note: "Maya wants recall first, precision after" — start with larger chunks + dense passage reranking. Concern: overlap increases index size and cost — need tradeoff matrix in POC.
reranker_tuning_notes: Preferred architecture: sparse ANN prune to top-100 candidates -> lightweight cross-encoder (quantized) to rescore top-N (N configurable 10/20/50). Razor constraints: cross-encoder compute budget during peak. Action items: run ablation on N={10,20,50,100} measuring MAP@10 and p95 latency. Consider distilling cross-encoder to a bi-encoder re-ranker for lower cost. Evaluate using negative mining from click logs; seed training data available (approx 350k clicks).
cost_latency_constraints: Hard constraints: p95 <= 250ms for interactive search flows; soft latency for background similarity scoring 1s. Budget target: <$0.15 per typical query (includes embedding lookup + reranker costs). Procurement will accept higher cost in first quarter if demonstrable ROI and clear optimization path (batching + quantization + caching).
